title: Whatever’s-in-the-garden tomatoes
excerpt: Good olive oil, a pinch of salt, and the last little taste of summer.
body:
Slice your ripest tomatoes and arrange them on a wide plate. Add torn basil, a generous drizzle of olive oil, and flaky salt.

Let everything sit for ten minutes so the juices mingle. Serve with crusty bread to catch every last drop. Sometimes the simplest things are the ones worth writing down.
